text:
ajay: quick rollup of postmortem follow-ups for the GPU capacity/autoscale incident. objective: owners, single-date deadlines, verification plan. reply with one-line confirmations or blockers.
kelly: i'll take cloud quota (aws). filing ticket now and will paste the id.
ajay: drop the ticket id when filed.
kelly: filed AWS-REQ-6270 (owner: kelly). asking for expedited 72h review.
samir: i'll own scheduler tuning and safe defaults: prefer short jobs in binpack, reduce preempt threshold to 0.6, add a small fallback pool, and include metric gates.
leah: updated headroom workbook with 6-week demand forecast and recommend a 15% scheduled buffer for peak windows. link: https://redwood/ops/headroom-guidance-2026
ajay: owners 5 please add one concrete due date each so PMs can track.
kelly: AWS-REQ-6270 target approval 2026-06-12; infra nodes provisioned and smoke-tested 2026-06-14.
samir: scheduler plan: PR by 2026-06-03, canary rollout 2026-06-05, full rollout 2026-06-09 if canary metrics are green. will define rollback gates (p95 delta < 5%).
leah: headroom actions i own: (1) add scheduled autoscale buffer for identified peaks (owner: leah) due 2026-05-30; (2) create telemetry alert headroom_percent < 12% for 5m (owner: infra-alerts) due 2026-05-27.
infra-alerts-bot: created alert ALRT-4570 headroom_percent < 12% for 5m. assigned to oncall.
ajay: who will run post-change regression verification and attach artifacts?
samir: i'll run the ml-evals regression suite and attach before/after dashboards to RI-1654. i'll include a short checklist for rollback conditions.
kelly: ops-infra QA for provisioning is owner=rafael. rafael, can you confirm provisioning windows once quota clears?
rafael: confirmed. provisioning & smoke tests scheduled 2026-06-14 to 2026-06-15 pending quota approval. will include node readiness and kube-level checks.
leah: noticing recurring spikes Tue 02:00 UTC that map to batch retrain start times. mitigation options: stagger retrain start times or assign retrains to a dedicated pool. owner=ml-platform (tanya). target 2026-06-13.
tanya: acknowledged. ml-platform will prototype staggering and report back with a short plan.
ajay: created tracking tickets: RI-1654 Scheduler tuning + regressions (owner=samir) due=2026-06-09; RI-1655 Quota & provisioning (AWS-REQ-6270) owner=kelly due=2026-06-14; RI-1656 Headroom alert + scheduled buffer (owner=leah) due=2026-05-30.
samir: i'll attach perf logs, pod traces, and canary dashboards to RI-1654 and link results in the ticket.
kelly: propose a controlled burst test after provisioning: 3-hour window, 2x capacity to dedicated pool during a low-traffic slot to validate headroom and autoscale fallback. will coordinate with ops-infra.
rafael: agree. we'll run the controlled burst with clearly defined success criteria and rollback plan. suggested success = headroom stays > 8% and no P95 regression > 10%. rollback = immediate scale-down and traffic routing if error rate increases. i'll own execution.
leah: infra-alerts, can you add a temporary test rule to notify oncall if headroom_delta > 8% during the burst?
infra-alerts-bot: created temp alert ALRT-4571 headroom_delta > 8% during controlled-burst for 1m. assigned to oncall.
ajay: propose a 15-min weekly sync until these tickets are closed. suggested slot: wednesdays 17:00 UTC. first sync 2026-05-27 17:00 UTC. confirm availability.
samir: available.
kelly: available.
leah: available.
rafael: available.
tanya: available.
ops-bot: created calendar event "GPU capacity remediation check-in" starting 2026-05-27T17:00:00Z recurring weekly. invitees: ajay, kelly, samir, leah, rafael, tanya.
ajay: owners please add a one-line status to your RI ticket before the first sync. i'll ping 24h prior. any blockers?
leah: no blockers on my side.
samir: minor lint fix on scheduler PR; will push today.
kelly: waiting on quota team; otherwise ready.
ajay: thanks everyone 5 keeping this thread as canonical until all RI tickets are closed. please keep replies short and paste ticket ids/links. :white_check_mark:
